entries.title: Adobe Inc. (NASDAQ: ADBE) — the book report, as of 2026-10-16
entries.summary: US watchlist to shortlist, session 2026-10-16: ADBE, UNH, NVDA and META all REJECTED at Layer 1 (ADBE and UNH on asymmetry, NVDA on the Stage 3 technical floor, META on SBC and asymmetry); shortlist stays empty, no new qualifier and no displacement.
highlights: ADBE re-qualifies on price only at or below 241.36 and UNH at or below about 369.90, but each needs a fresh full review first
NVDA passes every financial test; verdict is a chart verdict (Stage 3, momentum gate NO_MOMENTUM)
META fails the SBC gate at 11.0% of revenue; reports 2026-10-21
